question: Where must the bulls be installed after arranging the structure according to rule?
premises: The arrangement must be completed according to the prescribed rule.
Bull figures are to be installed as part of this procedure.
The head position is specified as their placement location.
inference: Therefore, after arranging according to rule, one should install the bulls at the head.
uncertainties: The precise architectural referent of śīrṣaka is not fully explicit.
plain_english: Having arranged it according to rule, one should install the bulls at the head.
